timestampSemantics.sourceRetrieval: All sources were retrieved on 2026-11-19. Per-request clock times were not separately instrumented; date-only retrieval values deliberately avoid false precision.
timestampSemantics.observationMeaning: Facts were reviewed against already-read primary-source content at this recorded clock time. This is not source publication time or the date a planned event occurred.
timestampSemantics.effectiveAt: Null for all rows; future schedule values remain in structured new_value and are not actual completion dates.
